title: #279 Remote Learning
prompt: In the future, students may have the choice of studying at home by using technology such as computers or television instead of studying at traditional schools. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages thereof.

promptSegments.text: In the future, students may have the choice of studying at home by using technology such as computers or television instead of studying at traditional schools.

requirements.en: Discuss the important advantages and disadvantages.
